what.intro: TNClub Sightread is a free web app for learning and practicing piano interactive sight-reading.
what.falling_notes_desc: TNClub Sightread is great for beginners – you can play songs without needing to learn complex sheet music right away. TNClub Sightread creates an intuitive Falling Notes visualization, similar to popular rhythm games.
what.caption_falling_notes: Falling Notes mode with note labels
what.sheet_hero_desc: For those who want to learn sheet music, TNClub Sightread offers Sheet Hero (beta) mode. Sheet Hero acts as a bridge between falling notes and full sheet music. Notes are laid out on a musical staff with simplified timing.
what.caption_sheet_hero: Sheet Hero (beta) mode with note labels

gettingStarted.subtitle: Connect a keyboard. Start slow. Gradually speed up.
gettingStarted.separate_hands: When initially learning a song, we recommend learning left and right hands separately. You can slow down the song using the BPM controls by at least 50%. Practicing slowly with good form is far more effective than rushing at full speed.
gettingStarted.wait_mode: If you connect a MIDI keyboard via USB, enable Wait mode – the song will pause until you press the correct key.
gettingStarted.education: TNClub Sightread works best alongside regular practice and formal music education.

musicSelection.intro: The catalog consists of two components: built-in pieces and local MIDI file imports.
musicSelection.builtin: Includes curated public domain classical and practice pieces.
musicSelection.upload: Upload your own .mid files directly to practice; files remain stored safely in your browser.

browserCompatibility.intro: TNClub Sightread is fully compatible with modern browsers like Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Mozilla Firefox.
browserCompatibility.midi_note: For connecting a MIDI keyboard via USB, a WebMIDI capable browser (such as Chrome, Edge, or Brave) is recommended.

roadmap.intro: Exciting features currently planned for future updates:

items.mobile: Mobile tablet and phone optimized layout.
items.musicxml: MusicXML file import and full sheet music renderer.
items.scoring: Practice scoring and performance progress tracking.
items.freeplay_record: Record performances in Free Play mode and share links.
items.training_games: Interactive note recognition games and sight-reading drills.

feedback.text: Found a bug or have a feature suggestion? Contributions and community feedback are welcome!

recommendations.usb_advice: TNClub Sightread works best with keyboards supporting USB MIDI output for minimal latency.
recommendations.beginner_desc: Portable 61-key or 88-key electronic keyboards with USB MIDI.
recommendations.intermediate_desc: Full 88-key weighted digital pianos for authentic key action.

attributions.intro: Some music arrangements featured are shared by the community under open licenses.
attributions.thanks: Grateful to all contributors and original arrangers.
